---
title: "Quick check: RASopathy likelihood ratios using genome/exome-wide COSMIC data only"
output: html_document
date: "2026-07-22"
---

# Aim

COSMIC ascertainment mixes genome/exome-wide sequencing with targeted
cancer-gene panels, each with very different per-gene sensitivity, which
could in principle bias the somatic-evidence likelihood ratios (LRs), in
particular the "0 observations -> benign-supporting" rule. This script checks
whether that is the case. The main analysis (`Likelihood_ratio_threshold_calcs.Rmd`) uses
`n_COSMIC_codon_count`, the combined genome+targeted-panel missense codon
count. This script instead uses **`n_COSMIC_genome_codon_count`** -- restricted
to genome/exome-wide COSMIC studies only, excluding the targeted cancer gene
panels -- to check whether the RASopathy LRs at our ACMG thresholds ($>0$,
$>2$, $>10$) hold up under this more uniformly-ascertained (but sparser) COSMIC
subset. Both columns already exist in the annotated variant list files, so
this is a straightforward re-run of the same LR formula on a different column
-- no new joins or data required.

This quick check confirmed the RASopathy ACMG thresholds ($>2$/Moderate,
$>10$/Strong, $=0$/benign-supporting) all hold up under genome/exome-only
ascertainment, so `n_COSMIC_genome_codon_count` has since been added as a
first-class feature in `Likelihood_ratio_threshold_calcs.Rmd` (alongside
`n_COSMIC_codon_count`), and is shown as panel (b) of Supplementary Figure S5
in `Scripts/Analysis/Figures_for_somatic_germline_paper.Rmd` (panel (a) being
the combined genome+targeted-panel COSMIC count used as the default
throughout the rest of the paper). This standalone script is retained as a
leaner, from-scratch reference implementation of the same check.

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

# 1. Load data (same source files as the main LR analysis)

```{r load, message=FALSE}
read_variants <- function(path) {
  read_tsv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      n_sperm             = n_sperm_twinsUK,
      n_sperm_codon_count = n_sperm_twinsUK_codon_count
    )
}

clinvar_path   <- read_variants("../../Data/Variant_lists/Clinvar_DDG2P_missense_path_annot_260526_public.tsv.gz")
DNMs_31k       <- read_variants("../../Data/Variant_lists/DNMs_31k_missense_annot_260526_public.tsv.gz")
biobank_benign <- read_variants("../../Data/Variant_lists/Biobank_missense_variants_annot_260526_public.tsv.gz")

RASopathies <- read_csv("../../Data/Gene_definitions/RASopathy_genes_VCEP_030425.csv",
                        show_col_types = FALSE) %>% pull(gene)
```

# 2. Build genome/exome-only vs. combined comparison datasets

```{r transmute}
transmute_variants <- function(df, class_label) {
  df %>% transmute(
    gene,
    n_COSMIC_codon_count        = as.numeric(n_COSMIC_codon_count),
    n_COSMIC_genome_codon_count = as.numeric(n_COSMIC_genome_codon_count),
    class                       = class_label
  ) %>%
    filter(gene %in% RASopathies)
}

ben <- transmute_variants(biobank_benign, "Benign")

Clinvar_unique_vs_biobank <- bind_rows(transmute_variants(clinvar_path, "Pathogenic"), ben)

Clinvar_long_vs_biobank <- bind_rows(
  clinvar_path %>%
    mutate(NumberSubmitters_clean = ifelse(is.na(NumberSubmitters_clean), 1L, NumberSubmitters_clean)) %>%
    uncount(NumberSubmitters_clean) %>%
    transmute_variants("Pathogenic"),
  ben
)

DNMs_31k_vs_biobank <- bind_rows(
  DNMs_31k %>%
    mutate(n_DNM = ifelse(is.na(n_DNM), 1L, n_DNM)) %>%
    uncount(n_DNM) %>%
    transmute_variants("Pathogenic"),
  ben
)

DNMs_31k_unique_vs_biobank <- bind_rows(transmute_variants(DNMs_31k, "Pathogenic"), ben)

data_sets <- list(
  clinvar_unique_public  = Clinvar_unique_vs_biobank,
  clinvar_long_public    = Clinvar_long_vs_biobank,
  DNMs_31k_long_public   = DNMs_31k_vs_biobank,
  DNMs_31k_unique_public = DNMs_31k_unique_vs_biobank
)
```

# 3. Likelihood ratio calculation (identical formula to `Likelihood_ratio_threshold_calcs.Rmd`)

```{r calc-lr-fn}
calc_lr <- function(df, feature, threshold) {
  df2 <- df %>% mutate(test_pos = .data[[feature]] > threshold)

  TP <- sum(df2$class == "Pathogenic" & df2$test_pos,  na.rm = TRUE)
  FN <- sum(df2$class == "Pathogenic" & !df2$test_pos, na.rm = TRUE)
  FP <- sum(df2$class == "Benign"     & df2$test_pos,  na.rm = TRUE)
  TN <- sum(df2$class == "Benign"     & !df2$test_pos, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (any(c(TP, FN, FP, TN) == 0)) { TP<-TP+0.5; FN<-FN+0.5; FP<-FP+0.5; TN<-TN+0.5 }

  sens <- TP / (TP + FN)
  spec <- TN / (TN + FP)
  lr_pos <- sens / (1 - spec)
  lr_neg <- (1 - sens) / spec
  se_log_lr_pos <- sqrt((1/TP) - (1/(TP+FN)) + (1/FP) - (1/(FP+TN)))
  se_log_lr_neg <- sqrt((1/FN) - (1/(TP+FN)) + (1/TN) - (1/(FP+TN)))

  tibble(feature, threshold = paste0(">", threshold), TP, FN, FP, TN,
        sensitivity = sens, specificity = spec,
        LR_pos = lr_pos, LR_pos_low95 = exp(log(lr_pos) - 1.96*se_log_lr_pos),
        LR_pos_high95 = exp(log(lr_pos) + 1.96*se_log_lr_pos),
        LR_neg = lr_neg, LR_neg_low95 = exp(log(lr_neg) - 1.96*se_log_lr_neg),
        LR_neg_high95 = exp(log(lr_neg) + 1.96*se_log_lr_neg))
}

THRESHOLDS <- c(0, 2, 10)
FEATURES   <- c("n_COSMIC_codon_count", "n_COSMIC_genome_codon_count")

lr_results <- imap_dfr(data_sets, function(df, data_set_name) {
  map_dfr(FEATURES, function(feat) {
    map_dfr(THRESHOLDS, function(th) calc_lr(df, feat, th))
  }) %>% mutate(data_set = data_set_name, .before = 1)
})
```

# 4. Results: combined (genome+targeted) vs. genome/exome-only

```{r results}
lr_results %>%
  select(data_set, feature, threshold, TP, FN, FP, TN,
        LR_pos, LR_pos_low95, LR_pos_high95, LR_neg, LR_neg_low95, LR_neg_high95) %>%
  arrange(data_set, threshold, feature) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "RASopathy LRs: combined COSMIC (genome+targeted) vs. genome/exome-wide-only COSMIC")
```

```{r results-wide}
lr_results %>%
  mutate(feature = recode(feature,
                          "n_COSMIC_codon_count"        = "combined",
                          "n_COSMIC_genome_codon_count" = "genome_exome_only")) %>%
  select(data_set, threshold, feature, TP, FN, LR_pos, LR_pos_low95, LR_pos_high95) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = c(TP, FN, LR_pos, LR_pos_low95, LR_pos_high95)) %>%
  arrange(data_set, threshold) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Side-by-side comparison")
```

# 5. Plot

```{r plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, message=FALSE}
library(patchwork)
theme_set(theme_bw(14))

acmg_lr_pos <- tibble(level = c("Supporting", "Moderate", "Strong"), lr = c(2.08, 4.33, 18.7))
acmg_lr_neg <- tibble(level = c("Supporting", "Moderate", "Strong"), lr = c(0.48, 0.23, 0.05))

plot_data <- lr_results %>%
  mutate(
    feature = recode(feature,
                     "n_COSMIC_codon_count"        = "combined (genome+targeted)",
                     "n_COSMIC_genome_codon_count" = "genome/exome-wide only"),
    threshold = factor(threshold, levels = c(">0", ">2", ">10"))
  )

p_pos <- plot_data %>%
  filter(threshold %in% c(">2", ">10")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = data_set, x = LR_pos, colour = feature)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = LR_pos_low95, xmax = LR_pos_high95),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), height = 0.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 2) +
  geom_vline(data = acmg_lr_pos, aes(xintercept = lr), linetype = "dotted",
            colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = acmg_lr_pos, aes(x = lr, y = Inf, label = level), angle = 90,
           colour = "grey50", size = 3, vjust = 1, hjust = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ threshold, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Positive likelihood ratio", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 20, 5.5, 5.5), legend.position = "bottom")

p_neg <- plot_data %>%
  filter(threshold == ">0") %>%
  mutate(threshold = "= 0 (benign-supporting)") %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = data_set, x = LR_neg, colour = feature)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = LR_neg_low95, xmax = LR_neg_high95),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), height = 0.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 2) +
  geom_vline(data = acmg_lr_neg, aes(xintercept = lr), linetype = "dotted",
            colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = acmg_lr_neg, aes(x = lr, y = Inf, label = level), angle = 90,
           colour = "grey50", size = 3, vjust = 1, hjust = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ threshold, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Negative likelihood ratio", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 20, 5.5, 5.5), legend.position = "bottom")

fig <- p_pos / p_neg + plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "RASopathy COSMIC LRs: combined vs. genome/exome-only",
    subtitle = "Across ClinVar/DNM, unique/count-weighted data forms")
fig

dir.create("../../Data/Figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave("../../Data/Figures/RASopathy_COSMIC_genomeExome_only_LR_check.png", fig,
      width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
